summaries.summary: Sends a simple remote request to the persistence manager using a specified action, target object, and boolean flag. It is typically used to execute remote operations such as deleting an object.

summaries.name: createRequest
summaries.summary: Creates and returns a Document representing a request for the specified name. It is typically used by assigning the returned Document to a variable.

summaries.name: serialize
summaries.summary: Serializes a given value and writes the resulting data to an output stream. This method is typically used to transmit serialized objects over a network connection.

summaries.name: deserialize
summaries.summary: Deserializes a value from an input stream into a Document object. This method is typically used to parse data retrieved from a connector's input stream into a structured document.
